verdict.rationale: Clerky is a legal-formation and paperwork service, not a platform where users build their own automations, so versioning, reviewing, and rolling back user-defined automations is a category error for this product. The change log on document sets and the attorney review features apply to legal documents, not automations, and the Partner API and MCP server do not let users define versionable automations, so none of these make the axis applicable.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can version, review, and roll back my automations
